identifiers.statement: Combined RefSpec 1.4+ (PR #251, ct-aory), Wikidata organization anchoring (PR #252/#254/#256, ct-39u8, 5,188 captured & qualified wikidata/reconcile batches), govinfo/collections capture scope fix (PR #260), and 4,200 daily cron capture receipts (runs 45749342153 + 45934598302): organizations.parquet 52,433 -> 50,409, organization_ids.parquet 59,433 -> 68,563, organization_redirects.parquet 0 -> 11,154, witness_organizations.parquet 154,841 -> 154,841 (44,707 org_ids updated).

groups.id: capture_scope.json|changed file without a comparison|unexplained
groups.cause: PR #260 adds the `govinfo/collections` family regex (`^https://api\.govinfo\.gov/collections/CHRG/[^#]+$`) to `model/registries/capture-scope.json` so nightly `fetch_meetings --gpo-since-days 7` relists stay within capture scope.
